FRONTEND (verified on preview URL, mobile 390x844): /admin/products (support@slangcart.com) — 'Publish all' + 'Unpublish all' buttons render below the vendor filter (testIDs products-publish-all + products-unpublish-all present); tapping Unpublish all via pointer events opens the bulk confirm sheet (testIDs bulk-publish-confirm + bulk-publish-cancel visible); tapping Cancel closes the sheet (data untouched, verified). Shop-home smart search (testbuyer@test.com, geolocation set to 13.7484,79.7027) — typing 'widget' into home-search-input reveals home-search-suggestions panel with home-suggest-0 ('Test Widget · ₹100') + home-suggest-1 ('Vendor One Widget · ₹100'); tapping suggestion runs full search and lands on Results with 1 matching product tile shown. Product detail /product/{id} — hero shows the product COVER (image_url) as the first (and only, for products with no gallery) image. TABLET (1024x1366 + 1280x800) — CRITICAL layout defect confirmed: the SubscribeBanner is rendered ~188px wide inside the tablet phone-frame, causing 'Activate subscription · ₹118' to wrap letter-by-letter vertically (screenshots iter62_shop_tab_1024.png / iter62_shop_tab_1280.png). The tablet phone-frame maxWidth=504 (READABLE_MAX_WIDTH+24, /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:228) forces the entire shop UI into ~500px column, so gridColumnsFor(1280)=5 (product-grid-card.tsx:53) mismatches reality — grid never renders 5-up in the frame. Also, the preview DB has ZERO admin shop-layout blocks configured, so the /shop home for testbuyer shows only the search bar, subscribe banner, and 'All'/'More' chips — NO product grid on the home at any viewport; a search flow was required to see product cards. Backend routing / auth all healthy.

ui_bugs.issue: On tablet viewports (1024x1366 & 1280x800) the SubscribeBanner renders ~188px wide inside the wrapping .phoneFrame (maxWidth=504), so 'Activate subscription · ₹118' wraps to a single-letter column (screenshots iter62_shop_tab_1024.png / iter62_shop_tab_1280.png). Root cause: the banner sits in a flex-row with the shop header controls; on the narrower tablet frame it gets squeezed to a fraction of the row. Reference: /app/frontend/src/subscription.tsx SubscribeBanner + /app/frontend/src/shop-home.tsx line ~666 (paddingHorizontal container).

gridColumnsFor(1280)=5 / (1024)=4 but the app wraps every tablet screen in .phoneFrame with maxWidth: READABLE_MAX_WIDTH+24 = 504. So even though the code advertises 4-5 columns on tablet, the actual rendering width is ~490px inside the frame, and a 5-up grid at 490px = ~98px/tile which is unusable. Either drop the phone-frame for Shop, OR compute cols from the parent width (onLayout) instead of useWindowDimensions() at ProductGridCard. References: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:80-91 & 228, /app/frontend/src/product-grid-card.tsx:52-63.

issues: Default Shop tab renders NO product grid at any viewport — only the search bar + subscribe banner + 'All'/'More' chips. The 4 published testvendor+admin products for 517644 (Test Widget, Vendor One Widget, Vendor Two Gadget, and Premium Gift Hamper) are only reachable via the search box, not from the home. Likely because no shop-layout blocks are configured for this pincode. Fix: either seed a fallback 'All products' block or auto-render an 'All products near you' grid when the layout is empty.

action_items: HIGH: Fix tablet SubscribeBanner rendering — on tablet the banner is squeezed to ~188 px inside .phoneFrame and its text wraps letter-by-letter (see iter62_shop_tab_1024.png). Either give the banner a flexBasis: '100%' inside its row, or move it out of the shop-home top flex-row on tablet-frame widths.

HIGH: Resolve gridColumnsFor(width) vs .phoneFrame(maxWidth=504) contradiction. On 1024/1280 tablets the actual render width is ~490 px inside the phone frame, but gridColumnsFor returns 4-5 → tiles collapse. Either: (a) drop the phone frame for Shop on tablet, or (b) compute cols from the parent onLayout width instead of useWindowDimensions(), or (c) cap gridColumnsFor to 2 when inside the frame.

MEDIUM: The preview DB has zero admin shop-layout blocks for pincode 517644, so testbuyer's Shop home shows NO product grid on any viewport (only search + banner + chips). Consider auto-rendering an 'All products near you' block when the layout is empty so the user isn't stuck at an apparently-empty shop.

LOW: Admin products grid still shows blank tiles for testvendor's 3 products (Test Widget / Vendor One Widget / Vendor Two Gadget) because those DB docs have image_url:'' AND images:[] — nothing to render. Admin needs to upload photos; this is a data problem, not a code bug. The image-endpoint fix (200 for unpublished) works whenever an image IS present.
critical_code_review_comments: product-grid-card.tsx:62 uses useWindowDimensions() but the actual render happens inside the .phoneFrame constrained to maxWidth=504. Prefer onLayout of the parent grid container so col-count matches real available width.

shop-home.tsx renders the SubscribeBanner in a horizontal container with paddingHorizontal:spacing.screen; on tablet-frame this leaves ~188px of horizontal room for the banner text — either force full-row width for the banner or reduce its side content on <500px.

products_public.py get_product_image (line 632) correctly serves unpublished — good fix. Also correctly returns 1x1 PNG when no src exists, so admin grid tiles never render 'broken image' icons; verified.

RN-Web Playwright quirk (also flagged in iter61): TouchableOpacity onPress does NOT fire via page.click(force=True) — you MUST synthesize the pointer events (pointerdown + pointerup + click, pointerType:'mouse', pointerId:1) via page.evaluate for RN-Web tap detection. This is what made the admin publish-all confirm modal appear + cancel work. rca_of_issue: Backend: no open bugs. Frontend tablet bug RCA: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx TabletContainer wraps every screen on width>=900 in a .phoneFrame styled with maxWidth: READABLE_MAX_WIDTH+24 = 504 px (see styles.phoneFrame lines 225-240). This is intentional — the design goal is to show the mobile app 'in a phone shell' on desktop for the emergent preview. HOWEVER, /app/frontend/src/product-grid-card.tsx:62 uses useWindowDimensions() (which reports the OUTER 1280 px, not the ~490 available inside the frame) to pick gridColumnsFor -> returns 4-5 columns, so tiles collapse. Similarly /app/frontend/src/shop-home.tsx puts the SubscribeBanner inside a flex-row alongside other header controls; at the phone-frame's narrow width the banner gets flex-shrunk to ~188 px and its text wraps letter-by-letter. Repro: open https://vendor-network-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com/shop at 1024x1366 or 1280x800 → the purple 'Activate subscription · ₹118' block on the Shop home is a ~188x191 square with vertical letter-stacking. Screenshot: iter62_shop_tab_1024.png. Mitigation: (1) either render the mobile app full-width on tablets that are also emergent-preview widths, (2) compute grid cols from the parent onLayout width, and (3) force the SubscribeBanner to width:'100%' inside its parent so it doesn't get compressed by the horizontal siblings.
